# Pre-Order Deposit Manager Support

Welcome to Pre-Order Deposit Manager, a WooCommerce extension for collecting deposits on pre-order products. We hope you find it useful; all are welcome here.

* Please see the [README](../README.md) for installation, configuration, and usage instructions.

* We want to ensure a welcoming environment for everyone. With that in mind, all contributors are expected to follow the [WordPress Community Code of Conduct](https://make.wordpress.org/handbook/community-code-of-conduct/).

* Found a bug? Please open a [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

* Have an idea for an improvement? Please open a [feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

* For general WooCommerce support (not specific to this plugin), see the [WooCommerce documentation](https://woocommerce.com/documentation/) or the [WordPress.org support forums](https://wordpress.org/support/forums/).
